messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy for service inference-api v2.4.0 -> canary 5% in us-west1. Change window 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks enabled. Watch SLOs: https://redwood.monitor/d/inference/canary :rocket:
jess: Ack — watching latency_p90 and error_rate. Kicking off smoke set 'smoke-prompts' and pinning evals for canary. Will notify if thresholds breach.
omar: Seeing increase in 5xx from canary nodes, spike over baseline. Quick prometheus check: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",status=~"5..",env="canary"}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",env="canary"}[2m])) * 100` -> 2.9% (baseline ~0.8%).
luca: :eyes: That's above auto-alert threshold (2%). Recommend pausing canary and rolling back canary nodes to stable v2.3.1. Also route new traffic to dedicated pool until we triage. tagging @jess @alex
alex: We should pin the model artifact while we rollback. Current traffic uses model redwood/gpt-3.8-q. Propose pin to redwood/gpt-3.8-q@2026-03-18 so we don't get drift. Any objections?
jess: No objections. Pausing canary now. Posting rollback intent in release notes: `rollback_to: v2.3.1`, reason: elevated 5xx in canary, suspected tokenizer streaming edge-case. Patch link: https://gh.redwood/inference/releases/245
deploy-bot: Canary paused by @jess at request of @luca. Initiating rollback of canary nodes to v2.3.1. Notifying change-window watchers and disabling canary traffic.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-081. Severity: sev2. Assignees: luca, jess. Runbook: https://go/redwood/oncall/runbooks/inference-canary-rollback. Pager notified.
omar: Post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate back to 0.6% in last 2m. Stable pool healthy. Will continue monitoring for 15m and report.
luca: Good catch. Action items: add e2e smoke test covering streaming/tokenization edge-cases to pre-release checks; add automated canary SLO guard to halt at 1.5% 5xx. Also schedule a short RCA session after the change window.
alex: I'll update release notes with the rollback decision, pin instructions, and plan for a hotfix branch for tokenizer fix.
jess: :white_check_mark: Closing this deploy early. Opening a follow-up thread for postmortem and test additions. Thanks all.
